Mehler–Heine on x=u/n and compact-uniform Plancherel–Rotach near alpha+1/2 provide sharp, explicitly evaluated constants and location limits, with all parameters and normalizations fixed. Direct saved-package finite checks pass, but do not replace the analytic proof.
